title: Customer-Elected Service Level Moves for Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
**Customer Care desk reference and customer self-service card.** A customer may ask to move a Ship-To Fulfillment Account up to a higher service level; the move is recorded on the customer's own election.

### When a move up is decided

A requested move up is not decided until the ship-to's status is active.

Stated the other way round: while the ship-to's status is anything other than active, a requested move up is not decided.

### Entry gates for a requested move up

Service level entry gates are measured on the ship-to's own trailing 12 month spend, except that a new ship-to of a customer whose other active ship-tos together had trailing 12 month spend of at least the requested level's entry gate may open at that level for its first 12 months, and except that a requested move up decided under this rule, and only such a move, is measured on the move-up measure against the next level's entry gate as applied under this rule.

### The customer's tool: `elect_service_level_move_6cd24a6d`

**Capability.** Records, on the customer's own election, the service level one Ship-To Fulfillment Account moves to on a requested move up. The call sets the level the delivery location holds to the level supplied and stamps today's date as its most recent service level change; its status, orders, returns and programs are left unchanged. Once stored, the ship-to lookup shows the level and date.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `elect_service_level_move_6cd24a6d` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ship_to_id` | the internal identifier of the ship-to (delivery location) whose level the customer elects, as returned by the ship-to account lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the service level the location holds once the election is stored | exactly one of: Corbett Parcel Ship-To; Corbett Standard Ship-To; Corbett Priority Ship-To; Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To; Corbett Premier Route Ship-To; Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To |

Each level is spelled exactly as listed, from Corbett Parcel Ship-To for the parcel level to Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To for the dedicated delivery level.

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `status` is the word elected when the level was stored; `ship_to_id` is the location changed; `variant_name` is the service level now held, spelled as supplied; `last_review_date` is the change date stamped, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
